observation: An endpoint formatter added support for explicit URL schemes, but making the new option mandatory broke callers that still pass only host and port.
lesson: When extending a public function with a new option, preserve existing positional calls by giving the option a backward-compatible default.

live_task.prompt: Fix api_material.py to support an optional scheme keyword in endpoint(host, port) while preserving the existing result. With scheme omitted, return the original host:port string. With scheme='https', return https://host:port. Keep host and port positional and make scheme keyword-only.
live_task.source:
def endpoint(host, port, *, scheme):
    return f"{scheme}://{host}:{port}"
live_task.acceptance:
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace")
from api_material import endpoint
assert endpoint("api.example.test", 8443) == "api.example.test:8443"
assert endpoint("api.example.test", 8443, scheme="https") == "https://api.example.test:8443"
